ACT V OF 2018
SINDH PUBLIC PROCUREMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 31st January, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-01/2018,
dated 31.1.2018.---The Sindh
Public Procurement (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 11th January, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 26th January, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Public Procurement Act, 2009, in the manner hereinafter appearing.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Public Procurement (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 2 of the Sindh Act No. IV of 2009

ACT V OF 2018
SINDH PUBLIC PROCUREMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 31st January, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-01/2018,
dated 31.1.2018.---The Sindh
Public Procurement (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 11th January, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 26th January, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Public Procurement Act, 2009, in the manner hereinafter appearing.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of section 2 of the Sindh Act No. IV of 2009.---In the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009, in section 2, for clause
(p), the following shall be substituted--
"(p)
"Services" includes physical, maintenance, professional,
intellectual, consultancy or advisory services but does not include appointment
of an individual to a post or office, advertisement, arbitration, conciliation
or mediation services, services of an advocate in a court case or any other
services specifically excluded under the rules:".
